test_title: PYST 34: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

#: LNR:: MOS: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is,

Option 1) # = GIM, % = RTY

For # (GIM) to LNR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ace7e4ba230e555280095784900edfe0f6e23ca47e86c7d33933a3e9275658e8.png] 

 

For MOS to % (RTY)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aed62021ef55b0b72a6356d862b8bfeaef19c3144ba042875774a2e6e5784e81.png] 

 

**Option 2) # = GIM, % = RTX**

**For # (GIM) to LNR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7991c0c151072423778ced24778b9c11577df0eac88d3d53e11f129eb7a2fcc7.png] 

 

**For MOS to % (RTX)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eec752dd29d78c5207c13ca444c911b20dad83fa6e0ea709e3dc6ed175f8b62.png] 

Since the pattern for GIM to LNR (+5, +5, +5) is the same as the pattern for MOS to RTX (+5, +5, +5),

Option 2 is correct.

Option 3) # = GIM, % = STX

For # (GIM) to LNR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd814bbc68c64fce338085d80587334529f3592bb27815a85f356b92111c9169.png] 

For MOS to % (STX)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b33826bdf3509b9ad748b16efdf7c6085bdf06597bd444d947648930b1b282f.png] 

Option 4) # = HIM, % = RTX

For # (HIM) to LNR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eeeaeb6f2d8272d8c14a1c68e980c23bead5c61d5e012eced187483e2533333c.png] 

For MOS to % (RTX)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93eac1c761e8f0eba9f0c86876bb052cd4a4ef83042a79cc8359fd1c4a1c57ae.png] 

Thus, the analogy holds true only for **Option 2** where the pattern (+5, +5, +5) is consistent for both pairs.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
